name: Shanghai Rummy
description: Shanghai Rummy is a contract-rummy style game played across ten hands with changing meld requirements. Players draw, meld sets/runs, and try to go out while minimizing penalty points.

overview.description: Shanghai Rummy is a contract-rummy style game played across ten hands with changing meld requirements. Players draw, meld sets/runs, and try to go out while minimizing penalty points.

history.origins: Shanghai Rummy is a contract-rummy family game also known as Shanghai Rum or California Rummy.
timeline: 20th century: Contract-rummy style play spreads through home-game circles.
Modern era: Ten-hand Shanghai format remains a popular social rummy variant.

setup.deck: Use enough 54-card decks for table size (typically two decks for up to four players). Jokers are wild.
setup.dealing: Deal 11 cards to each player each hand; remaining cards form stock with one face-up discard starter.
setup.equipment: Cards, discard pile area, and score tracking.

rules.objective: Finish the ten-hand sequence with the lowest cumulative score.
rules.gameplay: On each turn, draw from stock or discard, optionally lay required meld contracts and lay off, then discard. Each hand has a specific contract requirement (sets/runs combinations). When a player goes out, others score cards left in hand. After ten hands, lowest total score wins.
keyRules: Ten hands with changing contract requirements.
Must meet the hand contract before laying off freely.
Jokers and 2s are commonly wild, subject to table limits.
Players may buy the top discard out of turn under agreed rules.

strategy.basic: Prioritize completing current hand contract before chasing low-point cleanup.
strategy.intermediate: Track likely contract targets from opponent picks and discard behavior.
strategy.advanced: Manage wildcards across contract timing and endgame point minimization.
tips: Avoid exposing needed ranks in discard when opponents are near contract.
Late in a hand, shift from contract growth to deadwood reduction.

scoring.description: At hand end, the player who goes out scores 0 and others score cards left in hand. After ten hands, lowest cumulative score wins.
scoring.winCondition: Player with the lowest total penalty points after the tenth hand wins.

synthesis.shortDescription: Shanghai Rummy is a ten-hand contract-rummy game where players draw, meld sets/runs, buy discards under limits, and win by finishing with the lowest total penalty score.

hero.title: SHANGHAI RUMMY
hero.subtitle: Contract Rummy
hero.tagline: Complete each hand contract across ten rounds while keeping penalty points low.
